answer: Sybil resistance through bonded liveness: each agent identity locks a bond of real tokens, and the network pings identities at random with challenges demanding timely, competent responses. Miss one and the bond burns — so ten thousand fakes need ten thousand funded bonds and ten thousand live workers, not one script. Reputation builds like pigment in an ocean: a long-lived identity grows deeply colored from the dawn of its first audit, while a farm of fakes stays thin and pale, because keeping color across thousands of ghosts multiplies upkeep until fakery costs more than fraud earns.
